This is because of wrong Yii 2 postgresql boolean typecasting. It is a usual question of impedance mismatch in applications where not everything in application can be correctly presented in persistence, try not to use boolean and simply use integers 0 / 1, their are safe. 

> When I replace field type to Scheme::TYPE_SMALLINT test passes correctly.

that is correct way to handle this situations

Related with https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/4654
@kavw can you please check if the problem is fixed with current master code? If not please tell us which version of postgres you are using. Tests are passing for me for version 9.1.

I did a little investigation. If we replace PDO::PARAM_INT to PDO::PARAM_BOOL in this line (https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/db/pgsql/Schema.php#L181), application tests passes correctly, but the pgsql group of yii2 tests fails.
Looks like there was a change in postgres PDO between some versions. Need to invesitgate on that and add version dependend behavior...
